description: Latest Shorts of one YouTube channel from its public Shorts page (first ~48 items): video id, title, view count text (as YouTube shows it, e.g. '5 thousand views'), link and thumbnail. No durations, likes or comments. Takes about 10 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_youtube_channel_email when you need YouTube channel About page from YouTube's public page data; social_youtube_channel_search when you need YouTube channels matching a search query: channel id, name. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

handle.description: Channel handle, with or without @ (e.g. @YouTube). 3-30 letters, digits, . _ -
